issues.issue: Two filled black primaries sit on one screen: "Review 6 clips" in the top-right header and "Apply changes" at the bottom-right of the style panel.
In the failed step 3 block, "Retry stage" and "Start over" are pushed to the far right of the block, detached from the sentence "Check that the model file is intact, then retry." that justifies them.
The style row shows six unlabeled color dots at 18px, and the selected state is only a 2px ring; the color's name appears once, for the selection, in a mono caption below.
The chip row mixes emoji (lightning, lock, person, tag) with the product's own line icons in the same column, so two icon languages appear side by side.
Rows carry four to six chips at the same size and saturation as the issue title, so ENG-416's title no longer outranks its labels.
The issue detail screen offers no visible next action: only the "+" in the title bar and ghost icons in the rail, while the body ends at Activity.
"Record" is a white outline button while "New project" is filled black beside it, so the action the screen exists for reads as the secondary one.
Date and duration columns plus the two grid/list toggle icons sit around 55% grey on the #f7f7f7 field, and the row checkbox outlines at the far left are near invisible.
The "Transcribing... 34%" pill is wedged mid-paragraph inside the transcript body and set in the same grey as the copy, so a status reads as text.
Three raw identifiers (d591db2c-0a82-..., 69e48d8e849ab9426f17022d, composer-5gohk1e06) render as unlabeled body text between the tab bar and the Tracks heading.
The Transcript row uses a different inner structure from the five track rows, and its trailing "?" control is clipped by the right edge and crowds the overflow menu.
The transcript line inside the timeline clip drops to roughly 7px grey text that cannot be read at normal zoom.
Transcript keywords are colored green, yellow and blue with no legend, so the color reads as decoration rather than as meaning.
The header holds two filled primaries at equal weight: "Save changes" in grey and "Export" in white.
The full-width "Auto headline" explainer banner sits directly above the clip grid, pushing the clips below the fold and competing with them for the first read.
The cyan "AI" badge appears on nine tiles while the same cyan fills #Export, the nav icons and the hero, so the accent marks nothing in particular.
The three hero tiles under "Create project" share one blue gradient and one weight, so the actual primary action is separated only by being wider.
The "Long video to shorts" label wraps to two lines while every sibling tool label stays on one, stepping that icon and its caption out of line with the row.

notes: P4 is the only product in the panel with an error screen, so its empty/error score is the only one judged against a real failure UI; the other five are scored from their cliplist and editor screens alone, where only P1 (per-row Ready states) and P2 (Transcribing 34%) show any status affordance. P4's cliplist and editor are the same three-pane screen with a different clip selected, so no distinct list or grid surface exists to judge. A red arrow drawn over the P3 editor image was treated as an annotation, not part of the interface.
